parameters.query: SELECT {{ $json.contact_id || 'NULL' }}::bigint AS contact_id, c.custom_attributes->>'sms_opted_out_at' AS opted_out_at, c.custom_attributes->>'exclude_from_drip' AS exclude_from_drip FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = {{ $json.contact_id || 'NULL' }}

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { outcome: i.json.outcome, enrollment_id: null, contact_id: null, flow: i.json.flow, phone: i.json.phone } }));

parameters.content:
## Seq: enroll contact
Input: `{flow, phone_number, email?, first_name?, last_name?, source?, checkout_url?, params?}`. Upserts the Chatwoot contact (outreach endpoint without content), checks consent, applies the flow's re-entry policy and inserts the enrollment. Returns `outcome`: enrolled, skipped_active, skipped_reentry, skipped_no_consent, unknown_flow, invalid_phone, invalid_flow.
